name: Split hero nested in an overlapping logos section
purpose: Carry the corporate page's H1, pitch, customer quote and demo CTA, followed by a customer-logo row, pulled up over the empty wow spacer above it.
description: The `.section_wowlogos.is-neg-overlap` block on /lms/corporate-lms: pulled up -16rem (-10 / -8 / -6rem at 991 / 767 / 479) over the empty WowContentHero 'corporate' spacer. Split row: avatar strip + trust line, serif 3.8rem H1 (2.5rem <=479), grey paragraph, quote card (italic quote, avatar, name, role + linked company) and primary CTA | 1440:920 product visual; stacks <=767. Below: centred lead line + 7 logos.
